g.title: SCI_QSP
g.text: Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Primary Mechanical Insult → Time-Windowed Secondary Injury Cascade → Axonal Sparing → Plasticity → ISNCSCI Motor Recovery

g.title: cluster_primary
g.text: 1. Primary Mechanical Injury (t=0, irreversible — NOT a drug target)

g.title: cluster_perf
g.text: 2. Systemic Hemodynamics & Cord Perfusion (modifiable within hours–days)

g.title: cluster_edema
g.text: 3. Cord Swelling & Ionic Dysregulation (the compression–edema–ischemia vicious cycle)

g.title: cluster_ox
g.text: 5. Oxidative Stress & Lipid Peroxidation (hours — the methylprednisolone target)

g.title: cluster_death
g.text: 7. Cell Death Programs (the integrator of clusters 3–6)

g.title: cluster_scar
g.text: 9. Astrogliosis, Glial Scar & Intrinsic Regeneration Failure (weeks — closes the window)

g.title: cluster_plast
g.text: 10. Spared Descending Tracts, Plasticity & Circuit Reorganization (weeks–months)

g.title: cluster_mp
g.text: 11. Drug PK/PD — Methylprednisolone sodium succinate (NASCIS II/III; window ≤ 8 h)

g.title: cluster_ril
g.text: 12. Drug PK/PD — Riluzole (RISCIS; enteral 50 mg q12h × 14 d)

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: 13. Drug PK/PD — Minocycline & Glibenclamide (edema- and microglia-directed)

g.title: cluster_symptom
g.text: 15. Symptomatic Pharmacology (does not alter motor recovery)

g.title: cluster_concept
g.text: 18. Quantitative Concepts Encoded in the mrgsolve Model
